description: An owner-financed (seller-financed) note is the loan a seller carries for the buyer after the down payment, and this tool computes the note amount, monthly payment, loan-to-value at sale, any balloon, and the total of payments and interest. Use it to size a seller-carry note before you sell the property or, later, sell the owner financed note. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

amortization_months.description: Months the payment is calculated over, e.g. 360.

balloon_month.description: Month the remaining balance is due, if the note has a balloon (optional).

down_payment.description: Down payment, USD (or give down_payment_pct). Default 0.

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment as % of the sale price (instead of down_payment).

name: owner_financed_note
title: Owner financed note calculator
